skillUse: Load only the named project-authored codebuilt-scene-generation SKILL.md for the build step as guidance. Do not load user-level skills or copy skill text into generated code.
If a skill conflicts with the brief or the playbook, the brief wins; say so in the report.
cinematic-camera is used for rules and vocabulary only (move names, depth of field, checking every frame). Do not call any pipeline a skill describes; build with frame-by-frame code.
The build skill is authored in this project, is limited to one SKILL.md, and is mounted at /skills/codebuilt-scene-generation read-only.
playbook: Script: 75 to 95 words, 30 to 40 s spoken, hook in the first second, numbers instead of adjectives, one idea per sentence, every fact checked and simplifications named.
Narration first, with per-word timestamps. Every cut, on-screen text and sound effect is placed from a word timestamp, never a guessed time.
Shot list: one idea per shot, 2 to 6 s each, about 8 shots; write the narration line, camera move and subject action for each.
Build every model from code in headless Blender; no downloaded assets.
Pose each frame as a function of time and render it as a still, with no keyframes, so any frame renders alone and the full render splits across processes.
Preview 12 to 24 frames at half size on one contact sheet, look at it, fix, repeat; most quality comes from this loop.
Full render at 1080x1920, 30 fps; captions word by word; keep text out of the top 10 percent and bottom 20 percent of the frame and the subject in the middle 60 percent.
Sound: music about 18 dB under the voice and effects about 10 to 13 dB under, measured as RMS on the stems; print the numbers, never mix by guessed gains.
Check: probe the finished file, run the subtitle checker, view a contact sheet of the finished video, and report what was not verified (for example, nobody listened to the audio).
